mapper.select: select tenant_id, token_hash, request_hash, snapshot_hash, expires_at, consumed_at, session_id from batch.batch_day_replay_preview_token where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and token_hash = #{tokenHash} for update
mapper.delete: with expired as ( select ctid from batch.batch_day_replay_preview_token where (consumed_at is null and expires_at <= #{now}) or (consumed_at is not null and consumed_at <= #{consumedBefore}) order by coalesce(consumed_at, expires_at) limit #{limit} ) delete from batch.batch_day_replay_preview_token token using expired where token.ctid = expired.ctid
